claims.claim: Two Drive Shafts (Axle Shafts) are available for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows suspension/strut assemblies and a radiator/condenser; no drive shafts are described as visible.

claims.claim: A Steering Rack (or Steering Gear) is available for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not mention a steering rack/gear; only strut/shock assemblies and a radiator/condenser are described.

claims.claim: A Radiator (or Condenser) is available for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report (photo 0) describes a large rectangular radiator/condenser unit with fins and a mounting frame.

claims.claim: Car suspension strut/shock absorbers are available for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report (photo 0) describes multiple shock absorbers/struts with rubber boots and springs.

claims.claim: The parts are being sold as is, for parts, repair or recycling.
claims.evidence: This is seller wording; witness report only confirms used/dusty/rusty appearance and does not confirm sale terms.

risks.risk: Radiator/condenser may be leaking, cracked, or have damaged tanks/fins; visual rust/dirt does not confirm integrity.
risks.proof: A close-up video/clip showing the end tanks and all seams plus a quick pressure-test/flush test result (or evidence of no leaks).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as scrap/for parts only (assume not guaranteed to be serviceable).

risks.risk: Suspension strut/shock assemblies may be incomplete (missing top mounts/bearings/strut hats/bushings) or internally worn.
risks.proof: A full set photo/clip laid out showing every component included (top mount, spring seat, bearing, bolts/bushings) and the full length of each strut/shock.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/for parts only (assume may require replacement of missing/worn components).

risks.risk: Vehicle compatibility is unknown (fitment to specific make/model/engine variant).
risks.proof: A photo of any part numbers/stamps/labels on the radiator and struts, plus the vehicle details the seller used for fitment.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case fitment (assume only useful for generic scrap/unknown fit).

risks.risk: Condition may be worse than it appears (heavy oxidation, bent mounting frame, or seized/failed components).
risks.proof: A clip showing mounting points from multiple angles and checking for bent frame/torn boots; include a shake/actuation test for any moving parts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with potential failure (no working guarantee).

risks.risk: Seller may be listing additional items (drive shafts/steering rack) that are not actually present in the shown items.
risks.proof: Photos/clip of the drive shafts and steering rack/gear themselves, clearly visible and counted.
risks.if_unproven: Priced only for what is verifiably present in the witness report (radiator/condenser + strut/shock assemblies).

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the radiator/condenser end tanks and seams (all sides) and any part number/label/stamp.
Provide a short video showing the radiator/condenser for leaks (or any pressure-test/flush result).
Show each strut/shock assembly fully, including top mounts/strut hats/bearings/bushings, and confirm completeness by laying parts out.
Provide close-ups of any markings/part numbers on the struts/shocks and radiator to confirm compatibility.
If claiming drive shafts and a steering rack, send photos/videos of those exact items so they can be counted and assessed.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies used suspension strut/shock assemblies and a radiator/condenser, so the item category can be priced at worst-case as scrap/for parts. Unverified claims about drive shafts/steering rack should not affect pricing until proven present.
